artifactRequest.question: Explain the discriminator and generator losses, gradient paths, detached tensors, optimizer targets and alternating updates. Use repeated phases and show the iteration cycle.
artifactRequest.scope: Default direct execution of the selected DCGAN training entrypoint, from one-time setup through its repeated per-batch discriminator-then-generator cycle and epoch-end outputs.

claims.summary: The artifact correctly binds separate Adam optimizers to netG.parameters() and netD.parameters().
It correctly shows discriminator BCE terms for real images against ones and detached generated images against zeros, summed before backward and the D step.
It correctly distinguishes fake_images.detach() in the discriminator branch from reuse of the original attached fake_images in the generator branch.
It correctly represents BCE on netD(fake_images) against real labels followed by generator backward and opt_g.step().
The repeated batch path preserves the source order: discriminator update first, generator update second, then the next batch.
The artifact labels the extra discriminator-gradient accumulation as inferred and conditions it on normal autograd and requires_grad behavior, which is the appropriate source-only qualification.
The artifact says accumulated scalar loss values are printed, but the print uses current loss_d.item() and loss_g.item(); d_running and g_running are accumulated and never read.
It correctly includes fixed-noise sample images and checkpoints containing both network state dictionaries after every epoch.
The source writes under samples/ without creating that directory; the artifact does not surface the resulting runtime precondition.

dataOrigin.answer: ImageFolder at data/celeba and its transform/loader setup are shown.

updatedParametersAndFitState.answer: D and G optimizer ownership and alternating steps are explicit.

losses.answer: Both discriminator BCE branches and the generator BCE objective are distinct.

evaluationBoundaries.answer: The artifact states there is no held-out evaluation and separates epoch sampling from evaluation.

outputs.answer: Images and checkpoints are clear, but current losses are incorrectly described as accumulated values and the missing sample directory precondition is absent.

uncertainty.answer: Imported model internals, runtime data, device, and framework-derived gradient behavior are qualified.
